svg.title: Plain autoencoder versus VAE latent space
svg.desc: Plain autoencoder codes are scattered with gaps, so a random point decodes to garbage; VAE codes are packed around N(0, I), so a random sample decodes to a plausible new image.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Why plain autoencoders cannot generate: gaps in latent space

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: PLAIN AE: trained points only, gaps undefined
